name: Vibraphone
author: Versilian Studios (VCSL) / packaged for DAW
attribution: Versilian Community Sample Library (VCSL) by Versilian Studios / Sam Gossner, CC0 1.0
desc: Vibraphone (motor off), 4 velocity layers: soft yarn mallets (pp/mp) and hard mallets (mf/f), long natural ring. Range F3-F6 (MIDI 53-89, playable C3-G6). Jazz, lounge, lo-fi hip-hop hooks, bossa, chillhop, film; comping chords and melodies. | Playable MIDI 48-91 (C3-G6), 4 velocity layers crossfaded. Params: pedal=1 lets notes ring until the next chord (sustain pedal, re-pedals on each new note); human 0-1 adds timing/level life; velcurve <1.6 = soft notes louder; bright = velocity opens tone; keytrack = high notes brighter.
